description: One record per rival APPEARANCE (not per rival). The chain of appearances is the rival's arc: growth is read by diffing records. Field naming follows the core data convention (camelCase). Any field canon has not set stays null/OPEN — prose existence is never converted into numbers by tooling.

encounterId.description: Stable id, e.g. hex-r1-first. Scripts and game data cite this id.

individual.description: True when this is a returning individual — the same creature as in an earlier appearance of this rival.

individualId.description: Stable per-creature id when individual is true; null otherwise.

knownMoves.description: Move ids (stable keys; display names resolve at render per rename law). Null = unspecified, never invented.

levelBand.description: Null until canon sets level numbers for this appearance.

spawnSource.description: For role=wildcard: the spawn-table area id (#7) the member is drawn from. Null for hand-set members.

rematch.description: encounterId of this rival's next appearance, or null. The chain is the arc.

rivalId.description: Cast id from cast.json. Hex is the canon rival; the format is rival-agnostic (dojo masters, Elite members reuse it per #45).

routeNode.description: Route-graph node id (#11) where the encounter can fire, or null if it is beat-locked rather than place-locked.

kind.description: What the encounter pays/costs, settled through the dojo circuit (#45).

storyBeat.description: Event-flag id (#12 event-flag.schema.json) that arms this appearance.

title: Mochiichao rival encounter record
